eyebrow: A button and a span can look exactly the same
headline: Looking clickable doesn't mean an AI agent *knows it can click.*

left.note: On its own, no built-in signal

right.note: *Built-in signal*: this is an interactive control

footline: Custom controls can work. But their appearance alone doesn't tell you whether they will.
closing: Then test whether an agent can actually find and use it.
